intro: Set a welcoming table every day. Grace’s seat and sculpted high back wrap you in support, while the frame feels timeless, so meals turn into easy conversations that linger without hurry.

features.title: Softer seating for long dinners
features.text: High density 24 kg/m³ foam cushions the seat so you linger comfortably through everyday dinners and celebration spreads, enjoying support that feels soft yet steady as conversations run long.

features.title: High back that supports your posture
features.text: An elegant, angular backrest supports your spine and shoulders, helping you sit tall without tension whether you are sharing a quick meal or hosting friends on the weekend.

features.title: Designer back that elevates your space
features.text: The distinctive designer backrest adds a crafted focal point, turning the chair into a style accent that complements wood tones, metals, and neutral linens across your dining area.

features.title: Mustard seat that warms the room
features.text: The rich mustard upholstery brings warmth and energy, pairing beautifully with dark or light tables so your dining zone looks welcoming from breakfast sunlight to evening candlelight.

features.title: Rubberwood frame for everyday strength
features.text: A sturdy brown-shade rubberwood frame gives durable support and dependable balance, made to serve daily family meals without wobble or worry so you focus on what matters.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
